summary: Completed testing of SSoC Season 5 P1 features: Live Footer Preview and Section Timestamps. Fixed 5 render function bugs that were causing combined endpoint to fail. All 10 backend tests passed. Frontend features verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: renderProjects, renderMentors, renderOrganizers, renderTestimonials, renderFAQs, renderAdvocates functions were missing default parameter values and null checks, causing combined endpoint to fail
P1 Feature 1 VERIFIED: Live Footer Preview renders correctly with brand description, social links, community/resource/legal links, and copyright
P1 Feature 2 VERIFIED: Section timestamps display as badges ('Just now', 'Xm ago', 'Xh ago') on panel headers and update on save
Backend /api/section-timestamps endpoint returns timestamps object correctly
Backend /api/admin/init includes sectionTimestamps key with all section timestamps
Homepage /api/public/init regression test passed - combined endpoint still working

context_for_next_testing_agent: P1 features verified working. Fixed render function bugs in admin.html that were causing combined endpoint to fail silently. The fixes add default parameter values (e.g., renderProjects(projects = allProjects)) and null checks before accessing .length property. All admin panel sections now load correctly via combined endpoint.

p1_feature_1_footer_preview.details: Live Footer Preview renders at bottom of Footer panel with dark theme. Shows brand description, social links (GitHub, Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram, Discord, YouTube), Community links, Resources links, Legal links, and copyright text. Preview updates when footer settings are saved.

p1_feature_2_section_timestamps.details: Section timestamp badges display on panel headers showing relative time ('Just now', '1m ago', '2m ago'). Timestamps update to 'Just now' when saving Hero section or Footer. Backend /api/section-timestamps endpoint returns timestamps object. Admin/init includes sectionTimestamps key.

homepage_regression.details: Homepage loads via /api/public/init combined endpoint. Console shows 'All site data loaded via single combined endpoint'. Hero section, FOMO counter, and footer all render correctly.
